ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: The council let the planting day go when the fields opened. It fades in a few days. Next spring, make a day of it (it can become a tradition), or put a planting day on the calendar yourself: Calendar → a new day, kept as a planting day.

The council left the herd out in the weather. It fades in a few days. Bring them in: a barn with animal beds (or a pen) keeps them sheltered, and next time the council can send people out to bring the herd home.
